Toyo business strategy briefing Dec 2024: ammonia EPC market share

name: Toyo Engineering
description: Japanese petrochemical and fertilizer-plant EPC holding a significant share of the global ammonia-plant EPC market (Toyo business briefing, Dec 2024), currently building a 1,500 t/d ammonia plant in the US on KBR technology; in alliance with JGC since 2022 for fuel-ammonia plants and Japanese import terminals. Traditionally a licensor-contractor for urea, methanol and ethylene derivatives.
products: ammonia and urea plant EPC and licences
